build_flags: gcc (ubuntu:18.04 image, glibc 2.27 — needed for stime). defconfig minus CONFIG_INETD. busybox_unstripped (debug symbols intact).
notes: Real-world Linux ARM64 busybox 1.21.0 (June 2013). Predates several documented CVEs. mdev_main @ 0x77bdc.

cves.notes: CVE-2013-1813: mdev applet handles relative paths from kernel uevent / sysfs sysfs strings without path normalization, allowing /../ escapes. The vuln is path-canonicalization, not a libc-sink shape; rsleigh has no SinkKind for path-traversal-class CVEs. Documented FN. v22+ work: add Path/PathTraversal SinkKind + symbolic-string-canon SAT model.
